project.name: EcoThread
project.description: Sustainable Circular Fashion & NGO Clothing Redistribution Platform with Home Pickup, QC Grading, Amazon-like Beneficiary Catalog, Tokenized Checkout, and Automated PDF Invoicing.

modules: openpdf / itext7 (Donation Receipt & 80G Tax Invoice PDF Generator)

database.primary: PostgreSQL (or H2 for local zero-config development)

frontend.stateAndRouting: React Router v6, Axios, TanStack Query

techStack.architecture: Decoupled REST API + Single Page Application (SPA)

capabilities: Schedule doorstep clothing pickups with date/time slot & address
Specify garment types, estimate bag count, and upload photos
Live status tracking of pickup request (Pending -> Assigned -> Picked Up -> Verified)
Download official 80G tax-exempt invoice / Donation Impact Certificate PDF
View personal environmental impact dashboard (Water saved in Liters, CO2 prevented in Kg)
Browse Amazon-style catalog of cleaned, refurbished Grade-A clothes
Filter by category (Men, Women, Kids), size (S, M, L, XL), season (Winter, Summer, Rain)
Cart & Zero-cost checkout using seasonal NGO monthly allowance credits
Order history & real-time delivery tracking to home or community pickup center
Driver task dashboard showing optimized cluster pickup routes by pincode/zone
Verify bag count on doorstep and update status to 'PICKED_UP'
Deliver collected clothes to NGO warehouse hub
Warehouse QC workstation: grade intake garments (Grade A -> Catalog, Grade B -> Bulk Drives, Grade C -> Downcycling)
Manage product listings, inventory levels, and categories
Allocate and manage monthly credit quotas for registered beneficiaries
Generate platform-wide sustainability and financial audit reports

coreEntities.name: PickupRequest
fields: status (PENDING, ASSIGNED, PICKED_UP, DELIVERED_TO_HUB, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)

instructionsForAntigravity: 1. Initialize Spring Boot backend in backend/ with Maven wrapper, Java 21, and application.properties configured for H2 dev / PostgreSQL prod.
2. Scaffold security package with JWT Auth Filter, SecurityFilterChain, and AuthenticationController (/api/auth/register, /api/auth/login).
4. Implement OpenPDF service to render official 80G tax receipt with donor name, item breakdown, and eco-impact badge.
5. Initialize frontend in frontend/ with Vite + React + Tailwind CSS, structuring Donor Portal, Beneficiary Amazon-style Store, and Logistics Dashboard.
6. Seed database with initial categories, mock donations, and catalog items for immediate testing.
